items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The mic is about where Eve was sitting... He’s just playing. So I asked him one night... Then I found out later on. One day, he and I were drinking together at the Pershing.

ctx.x: Oh man, and it’s a half-block long. He – and wide – that man would come in there and play, boy. He never even walked toward the mic. The mic is about where Eve

was sitting. He’s standing there and play and fill up that Pershing. That used to amaze me. Because one day I walked behind him to see if he was wired. He looked around at me as if to say, what’s . . . ? Because I said, this cat’s got to have a wire or something. He’s just playing. So I asked him one night. I said – because it hadn’t never really been but two cats that really impressed me with volume and stuff on the horn, was he and Ben Webster. Because I asked Ben Webster once. I said, “Mr. Ben, are you wired…
